items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: my nephew, which is my sister Rose

ctx.x: And Louie's a couple of years younger than you or so?

Yeah, I was a couple of years younger than me, just about a couple of years. And then we have, in the family we have my nephew, which is my sister Rose, who passed away a couple of years ago. Her son Danny Barker, and everybody says he's pretty good guitar and banjures. Played with all the named bands around New York. He's still in New York. He's trying to get his book together. Which I hope he does. Because I'm tired of hearing about that book.
That'll be a good one now when he gets it.
